newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron in venture with Nera.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron in venture with Nera.

text.p: Goldtron Ltd said on Tuesday its subsidiary Goldtron Telecommunications Pte Ltd had signed a memorandum of understanding with Nera ASA to jointly develop mobile satellite communications terminals.
It said in a statement the project would involve joint research and development for terminals with digital wireless Private Branch Exchange (PBX) capabilities.
The agreement will not have any material impact on the financial results of either company for the year ending December 31, 1997.
